content.short: TON Fish Box is the inaugural NFT collection of the TON FISH ecosystem featuring unique upgrade mechanics.
content.description: TON Fish Box is the foundational NFT collection for the vibrant TON FISH social and gaming ecosystem. Consisting of 9,999 unique pieces, it was the first project on TON to introduce a specialized upgrade system where holders can enhance their digital assets over time. These NFTs serve as a pass to various community events, rewards, and future developments within the TON FISH universe. By combining collectible art with innovative on-chain utility, TON Fish Box has established itself as a cultural cornerstone for NFT enthusiasts on the TON blockchain.
content.meta: Discover TON Fish Box, the innovative NFT collection with upgrade mechanics. Explore more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
